title: Compare and Contrast Practice 1
subject: rla
passage:
TEXT A - Two Study Rooms

Room North has large shared tables, movable chairs, and whiteboards on every wall. Room South has individual desks, fixed chairs, and sound-absorbing panels. Both rooms can be reserved by students for two-hour blocks.

TEXT B - Trail Repairs

On the east trail, workers replaced damaged wooden steps with stone steps that should last longer but required heavier equipment to install. On the west trail, workers repaired the existing wooden steps, which was faster and caused less disruption but will likely need more maintenance.

TEXT C - Two Project Methods

Leah sketches several small prototypes before choosing one to build. Omar selects one idea early and spends most of his time testing and revising that single version. Both keep notes about what changes improve their designs.

TEXT D - Transit Proposals

Plan Green would increase bus frequency along the existing downtown route. Plan Blue would keep the current schedule but extend the route to two neighborhoods that currently lack direct service. Both plans use the same number of buses.
